Duxiang Ren

President of the Swiss Chinese Ski Association · Ski Coach · Travel Planning

Building better travel planning in Switzerland for Chinese-speaking skiers and travelers.

Based in Switzerland, I work across ski education, travel planning, and community projects. Through the Swiss Chinese Ski Association, I help Chinese-speaking skiers and travelers experience the Alps with safer coaching, practical planning, and clear trip coordination.

What I Do

Structured ski coaching and travel planning for Chinese-speaking skiers and travelers.

✦

Ski Coaching

Private and group coaching for individuals, families, and Chinese-speaking ski communities in Switzerland.

⌂

Tourism

Planning systems and coordination for resorts, routes, logistics, and seasonal travel needs.

＋

Community

Events and group activities that connect Chinese-speaking skiers through shared ski projects.

Current Focus

Developing smarter planning tools for ski travel in Switzerland.

I am working on a digital project that connects professional coaching, multilingual support, resort information, itinerary planning, and smoother coordination for Chinese-speaking visitors.
